-- name: ListOrdersWithInvoice
SELECT
    o.id,
    o.placed_at,
    o.status,
    o.ship_city,
    i.number AS invoice_number,
    i.issued_at,
    i.due_at,
    i.amount
FROM dbo.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN billing.invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.customer_id = @customer_id
ORDER BY o.placed_at, o.id;
